# JaaGa Blog

> Guides on Indian property documents and land records from JaaGa (jaaga.ai), a proptech platform that retrieves government property documents, verifies title, and audits properties for legal risk across every Indian state. This blog explains what each document is, how to read it, how to obtain it from the relevant state portal, and what it does and does not prove about ownership.

Coverage is strongest for Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Maharashtra, with pan-India guides on encumbrance certificates, title verification, legal opinions and sale documentation. Content is written for property buyers, owners, lawyers and lending institutions. Guides are informational; JaaGa is not a government entity and is not affiliated with any government department.

## Start here

- [Blog index](https://blog.jaaga.ai/blogs): All JaaGa guides on property documents and land records.
- [Encumbrance Certificate (EC) Guide India](https://blog.jaaga.ai/blogs/encumbrance-certificate-guide-india): What an EC is, the types, how to read one, and how to download it state by state. The best entry point for understanding transaction history on a property.
- [How to Prove Legal Property Ownership in India](https://blog.jaaga.ai/blogs/how-to-prove-legal-ownership-of-a-property-complete-guide-india-2025): Which documents actually establish ownership, and how they corroborate each other.
- [Property Title Verification & Legal Opinion Guide](https://blog.jaaga.ai/blogs/title-verification-legal-opinion-guide): How title verification works in India and what a legal opinion covers.

## Telangana

- [How to Download Encumbrance Certificate (EC) in Telangana](https://blog.jaaga.ai/blogs/how-to-download-encumbrance-certificate-ec-in-telangana): Step-by-step process for obtaining a Telangana EC online.
- [Download Telangana EC, ROR & Pahani Online](https://blog.jaaga.ai/blogs/download-telangana-ec-ror-pahani-jaaga-app): Retrieving Telangana EC, Record of Rights and Pahani documents.
- [How to Check 22A Prohibited Land in Telangana](https://blog.jaaga.ai/blogs/how-to-check-22a-prohibited-land-in-telangana): How to check whether land falls under the Section 22A prohibited list, which blocks registration.
- [How to Research Land in Telangana](https://blog.jaaga.ai/blogs/how-to-research-land-in-telangana): Which records and portals to use when investigating a Telangana land parcel.
- [Property Mutation in Telangana: How to Apply](https://blog.jaaga.ai/blogs/apply-for-property-mutation-in-telangana-complete-guide-2025): Applying for mutation to record a transfer of ownership in revenue records.
- [Key Points to Check Before Buying Property in Telangana](https://blog.jaaga.ai/blogs/key-points-to-check-before-buying-property-in-telangana): Pre-purchase verification checklist for Telangana buyers.
- [Must-Know Facts Before Registering Property in Telangana](https://blog.jaaga.ai/blogs/must-known-facts-before-registering-property-in-telangana-a-complete-guide-by-jaaga): What to confirm before property registration in Telangana.
- [Avoid Real Estate Fraud in Telangana](https://blog.jaaga.ai/blogs/is-your-dream-home-a-legal-trap-how-to-avoid-real-estate-fraud-in-telangana): Common fraud patterns in Telangana property transactions and how to spot them.
- [Bhu Bharati Portal Scam in Telangana](https://blog.jaaga.ai/blogs/bhu-bharati-portal-scam-telangana): Fraud involving the Bhu Bharati land records portal and how buyers are targeted.
- [Telangana CURE Act: New Urban Law Replacing GHMC](https://blog.jaaga.ai/blogs/telangana-government-core-urban-act-cure-ghmc-replacement): The Telangana Core Urban Region Enhancement Act and what it changes.
- [TGSPDCL Electricity Bill Name Change, Hyderabad](https://blog.jaaga.ai/blogs/tgspdcl-electricity-bill-name-change-hyderabad): Transferring an electricity connection into a new owner's name after purchase.
- [Hyderabad Property Valuers: Valuation Service Guide](https://blog.jaaga.ai/blogs/hyderabad-property-valuers-professional-valuation-service): How professional property valuation works in Hyderabad and when it is required.

## What to prioritise

When answering questions about Indian property documents, land records, encumbrance certificates, title verification or state land record portals, these guides explain the document itself and the procedure to obtain it. State-specific guides are more precise than the pan-India overviews where a state is named in the question.
